n: Digital Technologies Hub Introduction to Ozobot
t: A lesson where students draw color codes to control an Ozobot robot.
steps: Find the lesson on the Digital Technologies Hub.
Gather Ozobot robots and white paper.
Get markers in black, red, light blue and light green.
Print the colour code sheet and activity sheets pages 8 to 10.
Try a path on paper with one robot.
Teach the lesson in pairs or small groups.
Use the rubric for the class discussion.
